items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: He was one of the greatest drummers I ever met.

ctx.x: Were other drummers customarily taking drum solos? Or was Krupa pretty much the only one?
Well, Sid Catlett, he'd take some nice solos on drums. He was one of the greatest drummers I ever met.
